bundle.shortDescription: Single-cycle waveform designer for hardware samplers
bundle.longDescription: MonoCycle builds precisely tuned single-cycle waveforms and exports them as PCM WAV files for hardware samplers. Two oscillators, ten combine modes, four shaping stages, a drawable wavetable and a preview that plays at the exact pitch the exported file will sound at when triggered at native rate.
